The petitioner states that the detenu was arrested on 31-1 96 in connection with Sabujbagh PS Case No. 39(39(10)95 under sections 323/326/379 and Sabujbagh PS Case No. 50(5) 95 and 73(5)95 and was sent to Dhaka Central Jail. On the other hand, the District Magistrate Dhaka vide order in Misc. Case No. 1199/95 dated 31-10-95 issued under section 3(2) of the Special Powers Act passed the order of detention and detained the detenu for a period of 30 days. The same District Magistrate vide order dated 14-11-95 issued the ground of detention and served a copy of the same upon the detenu in jail on 15-11-95. The Government in the Ministry of Home Affaire vide his memo No.602 Sha Ma Nira-3 dated 31-1-96 approved the order of detention passed by the District Magistrate and also extended the detention for a period of three months with effect from 30-11-95. 

 6. Accordingly, we make the Rule absolute. We direct that the detenu Ms. Jalaluddin Khan alias Jalal be set at liberty at once if not wanted in connection with any other case.
